title: The Reliable worker in the mill
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：reliable　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reliable 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the tailor wrote of ① a reliable worker in the mill in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② more reliable than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the reliable ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most reliable worker in the mill anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the order for November 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too reliable to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the reliable ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a reliable source of the news, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as reliable as the source of the news they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was reliable or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something reliable, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite reliable; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the reliable ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, without complaint, she wrote of another reliable worker in the mill in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more reliable than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most reliable source of the news in the whole shop, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the reliable ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 可靠（前置定语 a reliable worker in the mill：1970 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件可靠的工人）
B. adj. 可靠／可信（比较级 more reliable than：文中两处，一处比磨坊里可靠的工人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 可靠／可信（最高级 the most reliable：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 可靠（表语 too reliable to do：母亲觉得它太可靠，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 可信（前置定语 a reliable source of the news：叔叔把整件事称作一桩可信的来源）
F. adj. 可信（同级比较 as reliable as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩消息的可信来源相比）
G. adj. 可信（后置定语 something reliable：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 可信（受程度副词修饰 quite reliable：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a reliable worker in the mill
the most reliable worker in the mill anybody
a reliable source of the news
The most reliable source of the news in

answers.why: reliable 意为“可靠”，1970 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件可靠的工人”，此处作前置定语 a reliable worker in the mill。
reliable 意为“可靠”，此处用比较级 more reliable than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
reliable 意为“可靠”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说它是裁缝铺里最可靠的一件，故用最高级 the most reliable worker in the mill。
reliable 意为“可靠”，母亲认为这件东西“太可靠了，谁也用不上”，too reliable to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
reliable 意为“可信”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩可信的来源”，此处作前置定语 a reliable source of the news。
reliable 意为“可信”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩消息的可信来源一样可信”，同级比较用 as reliable as。
reliable 意为“可信”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“可信的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something reliable。
reliable 意为“可信”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当可信”，quite 修饰原级 reliable。
reliable 意为“可信”，1980 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要可信”，故用比较级 more reliable than。
reliable 意为“可信”，母亲 1982 年说的是“整个裁缝铺里最可信的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most reliable source of the news。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件可靠的工人。（a reliable worker in the mill）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更可靠。（more reliable than …）
母亲觉得它太可靠，谁也用不上。（too reliable to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩可信的来源。（a reliable source of the news）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩消息的可信来源一样可信。（as reliable as …）
到了 1977 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件可信的东西。（something reliable）
answers: In 1970 the tailor wrote of a reliable worker in the mill in the order.
Everybody said it was more reliable than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too reliable to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a reliable source of the news.
He said nobody would call it as reliable as the source of the news they had once had.
By 1977 the order asked for nothing but something reliable.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reliable 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the tailor wrote of a reliable worker in the mill in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most reliable worker in the mill in the shop, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too reliable to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a reliable source of the news, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite reliable, and everybody laughed.
The reliable ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
